scientific_integrity: Self-contained analytic all-even-dimension reconstruction proof, independent symbolic factor identity check, and supplementary finite diagnostics; no independent mathematical audit or exhaustive-prior-literature certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to exact complete unoversampled Fourier intensities for vectors with at most two nonzeros and even cyclic orders at least four; does not prove noisy stability, uniqueness for three-sparse or arbitrary signals, or minimality of three complex masks. An unindexed equivalent older special-purpose two-sparse design remains possible.
title: Three bounded-contrast Fourier masks resolve every two-sparse even-cycle phase ambiguity
